# Tropical Storm

Tropical Storm is a mint-green G4 Pegasus mare with pink hair, golden eyes, and three blue raindrops for a cutie mark. She shares a character design and cutie mark with Sunshower Raindrops, but they are cataloged separately.

[![Hasbro, 2013 — Tropical Storm collector card, archived by MLP Merch](https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-qg-ylee8iro/Vp1K19cHdaI/AAAAAAAAO9w/flWVIl6T3js/s1600/mlp-wave-9-tropical-storm-blind-bag-card.jpg)](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bag-cards/pony/tropical-storm/)

- **Name and personality:** Tropical Storm is an official Hasbro merchandise name, printed on her 2013 Rainbow Collection blind-bag card, no. 17 (wave 9). The card says she “loves to play outside, rain or shine!” Her figure uses the Rainbow Dash mold. See the [collector's pose index](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/G4/Pose/rainbow.html).
- **Television continuity:** The [Friendship is Magic Pegasus catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) identifies her as a background weather-team mare in Winter Wrap Up (S1E11, December 24, 2010). The merchandise name is not known to be spoken on television; the identification of the earlier background design is a fan-catalog attribution.
- **Speaking status:** No individually identifiable dialogue, voice actor, alternate identity, or additional film/comic appearance was verified.

## Important moments

- **Joining Ponyville's weather team — Winter Wrap Up (S1E11):** The character catalog identifies her near the end of the song, eyes closed and wearing the blue team vest, associating her with Ponyville's communal preparations for spring.
